ai.title: High School Aviation Maintenance Programs: FAA Should Assess Expanding Access to the Mechanic Knowledge Test
ai.raw_summary: What GAO Found The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issues certificates to aircraft mechanics and to the more than 200 aviation maintenance schools that train them. Eleven of these certificated schools are high schools, and 43 are colleges, universities, or career and technical centers that serve high school students. In addition, at least 43 high schools offer programs in aviation maintenance but are not certificated by FAA. The school representatives that GAO interviewed had little data on career outcomes but cited a range of pathways that graduates have pursued, including further training and enrolling in 4-year colleges. FAA-Certificated Schools That Train High School Students in Aviation Maintenance Stakeholders identified several barriers to students becoming aircraft mechanics, especially limited awareness of the career option among students entering high school. Stakeholders also offered options to address these barriers, such as internships with aviation industry partners to increase awareness. Some stakeholders cited as a barrier the ineligibility of students from uncertificated schools, who do not have the requisite work experience or additional education, to take the general written knowledge test—typically the first in a series of FAA tests that students must pass to become an FAA-certificated aircraft mechanic. trade.raw_summary: 高雄關表示，為加強與業界溝通、增進通關政策宣導成效，高雄關劉關務長芳祝於115年8月27日率領陳副關務長玉景、羅副關務長文禎及各通關單位主管前往高雄市報關商業同業公會辦理宣導活動，針對通關政策與實務進行說明，並與業者代表洪理事長正隆等理監事面對面溝通，廣泛聽取意見並交流。 高雄關說明，本次宣導活動包括輸美國貨品原產地聲明書線上作業、輸往歐盟之鋼鐵產品應檢附原產地證明書或加工證明書、自韓國及中國大陸產製進口冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品課徵反傾銷稅以及報關業常見違規態樣等通關實務。劉關務長表示，輸美國貨品原產地聲明書線上作業上線後，針對C1（免審免驗）報單，業者無須再提供紙本原產地聲明書，享受無紙化便利，因應國際貿易環境快速變化，簡化報關流程並提升通關效率是未來的趨勢。現場討論踴躍，互動熱絡，報關公會並特別向高雄關致謝，感謝協助展覽品即時完成通關程序，如期開展。此次活動除強化政策透明度，透過面對面的交流，快速找出解決方案，進而提升海關服務品質。 高雄關進一步表示，未來將持續透過各種方式與業界互動溝通，協助業者提升法遵意識與報關品質，共同打造更高效率、安全及便利的通關環境。 新聞稿聯絡人：林課員 電 話：07-5628223

trade.title: Heightened Import Disclosures for Supply Chain Visibility
trade.raw_summary: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is considering amending its regulations to give CBP greater visibility into the supply chains of goods imported into the United States. CBP is seeking comments on new requirements enhancing visibility into the parties involved in the importation of goods; integrating innovative technical solutions for the tracing of supply chains of those goods; and collecting foreign export documentation that foreign exporters are required to submit to the foreign customs authority prior to the exportation of those goods to the United States. With these proposals, CBP seeks to more effectively detect and interdict illicit importations, especially those that are illegally transshipped to evade compliance with U.S. customs and trade laws.

trade.title: Trade finance: how volatile financial conditions influence its availability and impact trade levels
trade.raw_summary: Global trade opens opportunities for economic growth. However, moving goods across borders, between exporters and importers, involves counterparty risk such as payment and liquidity risk. Trade finance facilitates trade by mitigating these risks.Using a new dataset, we find that volatile global financial conditions constrict the availability of trade finance, especially in emerging markets and developing countries. In addition, the level of development of local financial markets influences the supply of trade finance by global institutions.

trade.title: Media Credentialing Opens for the G20 Trade Ministerial in Milwaukee, Wisconsin
trade.raw_summary: Media Credentialing Opens for the G20 Trade Ministerial in Milwaukee, Wisconsin myarbrough Tue, 09/01/2026 - 13:25 WASHINGTON — On Wednesday, September 30, and Thursday, October 1, Ambassador Jamieson Greer will host the G20 Trade Ministerial in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. During the ministerial, USTR will lead discussions with the G20 Trade Ministers on a range of issues, including eradicating forced labor in global supply chains, updating the Most-Favored Nation (MFN) principle, denouncing the weaponization of trade in food, and addressing structural excess capacity and production. Members of the media interested in covering the G20 Trade Ministerial may apply for credentials by emailing MBX.USTR.Media@ustr.eop.gov no later than Monday, September 21. Approved media will receive confirmation with additional information regarding credential distribution, security screening procedures, media access, and other operational logistics. Additional media guidance will be distributed to approved credentialed media as the meetings approach. Media credentials are non-transferable and subject to security screening and approval. For more information and event updates, please visit www.G20.org . ###

trade.raw_summary: 日本最大的五金手工具DIY展於本(8)月27日至29日在幕張國際展覽館盛大登場，為協助業者拓展海外市場，經濟部攜手國內公協會籌組旗艦臺灣館，徵集涵蓋修繕維護、居家生活、五金、安全防護及衛浴建材等領域共51家臺灣優質企業參展，為本屆展覽第三大參展國，促成4,500萬美元商機。 經濟部貿易署說明，本次旗艦臺灣館特別與金屬工業研究發展中心合作設置「產業情境展示區」，以居家修繕及永續生活應用為主題，並透過專人解說，讓國際買主能直觀體驗臺灣產業解決方案。此外，另推出「Digital Zone」數位整合服務，運用數位科技展出臺灣參展商及手工具、螺絲及水五金等產業公協會會員資訊、產品及提供數位導覽服務，不僅提升現場採購媒合效率，更協助未能親自參展的臺灣企業同步取得曝光機會。 為提升臺灣館國際能見度，展覽期間辦理產品發表會、買主交流及「臺灣之夜」等多元活動，促進我商與國際買主對接，並邀請來自日本DIY領域具影響力的創作者參觀採訪，透過拍攝短影音及主題影片露出，將優質臺灣產品推廣至日本及國際市場。 經濟部貿易署指出，臺灣素有「手工具王國」美譽，每年為臺灣創造近40億美元出口值，穩居全球前三大出口國。面對全球DIY風氣結構性成長，加上日本因應高齡化、防災整備需求增加，以及大型通路對高品質、環保永續產品之需求提升，經濟部積極運用多元拓銷管道，協助臺灣企業掌握產業升級趨勢，精準對接海外大型通路買主，將高附加價值產品推向全球，爭取更高階的市場訂單。 經濟部表示，因應全球經貿情勢變化，政府運用韌性特別預算，透過籌組海外拓銷團、參與指標性國際展覽、邀請買主來臺及洽談採購等多元方式，協助臺灣企業拓展海外市場。繼日本DIY展後，經濟部將陸續組團參加芝加哥工具機展(IMTS)、美國汽配展(AAPEX)、慕尼黑電子展(Electronica)、杜賽道夫醫療展(MEDICA)及日本國際橡塑膠展(IPF)等國際大型展覽，並打造旗艦臺灣館，全方位協助多元產業海外拓銷。 貿易署發言人：胡副署長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7109、02-2397-7178、0966-525-106 業務聯絡人：貿易發展組黃科長 聯絡電話：02-2397-7306
